text:
samir: quick flag - dashboard p99 for /v1/query jumped to ~820ms at 15:14 but the endpoint tile p99 shows ~210ms. looks like an aggregation mismatch.
anya: did you check sample origins? aggregate may be including proxy/client while the tile defaults to server-only.
drew: also retries or cache_miss skew can blow the tail. small sample from traces: `ingress: endpoint=/v1/query origin=proxy fallback=true latency_ms=811 retry_count=1 cache_hit=false`
samir: ah ok. the UI sparkline didn't make the provenance obvious. we need a low-friction indicator.
ux: proposal: add a compact provenance chip next to each percentile (p50/p95/p99). chip shows primary origin and a link to a small breakdown on hover (counts + p50/p95/p99 by origin).
anya: and add an "include_retries" toggle in the percentile panel. default false. toggles map to `retry_count=0` filter.
drew: implementation note: telemetry already stores `sample_origin`, `retry_count`, `cache_hit`. backend can return an array of origin buckets with counts and percentiles. e.g.: `[{"origin":"proxy","p99":"811","count":"42"},{"origin":"server","p99":"208","count":"1834"}]` (we'll wire a stable shape).
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary/2026-03-24.15 rolled to eu-west at 15:11
samir: that aligns with the spike. action items: (1) quick console patch for provenance chip + hover (ux), (2) telemetry API flag `include_retries` and origin buckets (drew), (3) docs snippet explaining why percentiles can differ across slices (anya).
anya: i'll draft the docs blurb and put a pointer in the hover. keep examples short: origins, retries, cache hits, routing weight.
ux: i'll scope the UI change as a tiny patch (chip + hover + link to query). want this in the next sprint as a hotfix.
drew: i'll add the param and include origin breakdown in the response. will also add a simple SQL reproducible query for incident notes: ```sql
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,99) AS p99, sample_origin, count(*)
FROM telemetry.samples
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/query' AND time >= '2026-03-24T15:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-24T15:20Z'
GROUP BY sample_origin
ORDER BY p99 DESC;
```
samir: perfect. this should stop oncall from chasing phantom backend regressions. filing a short incident note referencing the query and two traces. thanks all. :thumbsup:
